## TotemAutomata 0.1.20

- Replaces selected Copper Golem source and sorting-destination particle chains
  with stable solid lines from TotemCore's shared world visualization API.
- Uses orange for the source, green for available destinations and red for
  unavailable containers.
- Applies terrain depth testing so walls hide occluded line segments while
  retaining current-target and blocked-state particle cues.
- Requires TotemCore 0.7.14 or newer within the 0.7.x compatibility line.

Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric · Java 25
